- A copy of LogiServe's most recent SOC 2-type report or summary.

Attached: LogiServe_SOW.pdf (scope), LogiServe_SOC2-summary.pdf (vendor-provided).

Ana — thanks for the heads up and for sending the artifacts.

Quick summary from our side: LogiServe will be treated as a subprocessor under Redwood's DPA. We typically require a subprocess agreement (flow-down) that mirrors the critical data-handling obligations in our DPA (security, deletion, breach notification, permitted purposes).

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal/Procurement: Redwood drafts an order-form amendment redline that references the subprocessor list and includes a condition requiring LogiServe to sign a flow-down agreement (we can also accept evidence where LogiServe is already contractually bound by equivalent obligations). See attached: OrderForm_Acme_redline_r1.pdf (initial redline).
2) Security review: we will triage the SOC summary and decide if we need the full SOC2 report plus a completed Vendor Security Questionnaire.
3) Evidence checklist: SOC2 Type II or equivalent; encryption at rest details; data residency/segregation statement; subprocess agreement (signed) or executed MSA addendum.

Marissa / Laura — can you weigh in on whether the redline looks ok and whether we should pause signature on DocuSign until LogiServe evidence is accepted? I opened a HubSpot ticket for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234/company/ACME-2319

Ana — if you can confirm the timeline for LogiServe providing the full SOC and signing the flow-down, we can put a conditional approval plan together.

Best,

Thanks for the ping, Karthik. Reviewed the SOW + SOC summary. Recommend the following conditional approval path:

Required artifacts before production onboarding (must be received and validated):
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) + AICPA bridge letter OR an ISO27001 cert + scope that covers processing activities.
- Completed Vendor Security Questionnaire (use attached template).
- Signed subprocess (flow-down) agreement mirroring core DPA obligations (security, breach notice within 72 hours, deletion/return, subprocess list).
- Confirmation of encryption at rest (AES-256 or equivalent) and tenant isolation details.

Operational controls:
- If LogiServe cannot provide a full SOC2 in the requested timeframe, we can accept a SOC summary plus a signed flow-down and a 30-day production hold with compensating controls (restricted access, reduced retention).

DocuSign and signature guidance:
- DO NOT proceed with final signature of the Order Form amendment until we have accepted the artifacts above or agreed on a compensating control plan. I will prepare a short legal memo to attach to the HubSpot record and request CA approval for conditional sign-off if needed.

Timeline estimate: with vendor cooperation, this is doable in ~10 business days. If Acme needs an immediate timeline, Sales should request a temporary exception and include the compensating controls in the Order Form exhibit.

I'll prepare a redline note for the DocuSign packet and a quick checklist we can send to LogiServe (I suggest they return the SOC and completed VSQ to contracts@redwood.com).

Marissa Cole
